name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2516: A cold review found the argument spy could fail the census it was watching - a conversion inside it raising turns a correct call into a test error, so the instrument reports its own failure as the subject. It snapshots defensively now. It also compared sources as an ordered tuple, asserting a guarantee the helper does not owe; a guard that fails for a reason that is not a defect gets loosened rather than read. Changed to a set comparison, and calling with only the first source is still caught while a mere reorder is not.
